Renowned for his paintings, graphic art, and monumental-decorative works, you can see the artist progress and evolve through the versatility of his style and skill. </p><p style="--font-selector:Q1VTVE9NO0ludGVyIERpc3BsYXkgUmVndWxhcg==;--framer-font-family:"Inter Display Regular", "Inter Display Regular Placeholder", sans-serif;--framer-font-size:20px;--framer-line-height:1.3em;--framer-text-color:var(--token-5f55e884-f769-43ab-8179-a221ba5cd45c, rgb(15, 16, 17))" class="framer-text"><br class="framer-text trailing-break"></p><p style="--font-selector:Q1VTVE9NO0ludGVyIERpc3BsYXkgUmVndWxhcg==;--framer-font-family:"Inter Display Regular", "Inter Display Regular Placeholder", sans-serif;--framer-font-size:20px;--framer-line-height:1.3em;--framer-text-color:var(--token-5f55e884-f769-43ab-8179-a221ba5cd45c, rgb(15, 16, 17))" class="framer-text">After becoming a member of the National Union of Artists in Ukraine, he gained notable recognition in the 1980’s through avant-garde creations.
